lines.text: For a year, he wrote to her every night.
And every night, he sent the letter up in fire.
Until the night it did. One word.
She had only ever wanted him to rest.

omni.ref_text: Long ago, when the hills were young, the lanterns of the valley were lit by hand, one by one, every single evening.
